dedupe_keys.name: katalog inderaja remote sensing data catalogue of brin indonesia

description: Katalog Inderaja is the remote sensing data catalogue of the Data and Information Centre of the Indonesian National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN), which took over the former LAPAN data services. It lets users check which satellite images are held: low resolution (Aqua and Terra MODIS, NPP-VIIRS, Himawari-8, NOAA-19 and NOAA-20), medium resolution (Landsat 5 to 9, SPOT 2 and 4, Sentinel-2), high resolution (SPOT 5 to 7, ALOS, RapidEye, IKONOS), very high resolution (Pleiades, GeoEye, QuickBird, WorldView), radar (TerraSAR-X, Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR) and mosaics from Landsat, SPOT, PlanetScope and Pleiades. The page also links the BRIN Fire Hotspot system of MODIS and similar low-resolution data for environmental monitoring, the SPACeMAP mosaic platform and the national Earth monitoring system, with a user guide and an FAQ. Low and medium resolution images are free for users, while high and very high resolution images need set requirements; the government-licensed very high resolution data serves ministries, agencies, the armed forces, police and local governments, and universities must share research results; no open licence is stated. Caveats: the site is in Indonesian and the catalogue checks availability, not serving direct downloads. Coverage is Indonesia. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis, such as flood, fire and volcano monitoring around infrastructure; related records are the MYSA satellite open data catalogue and the BRIN SWIFtS space weather service.
